subject.title: Add SQLite snapshot artifacts under backup

question: Should OpenClaw accept `openclaw backup sqlite snapshot` as a core sensitive-state artifact contract now, or keep this PR draft until the Scout/Lobster pilot and stress harness prove the scope?
rationale: Automation can identify code and supply-chain issues, but it cannot choose the permanent core-versus-host boundary or the proof threshold for a new backup artifact schema that can carry sensitive state.

options.title: Keep Draft For Cleanup And Pilot Proof
options.body: Require the concrete cleanup first, then decide core landing after pilot or stress evidence clarifies the operational contract.

options.title: Land Core MVP After Cleanup
options.body: Accept the local-only core command once the concrete blockers are fixed and product/security reviewers approve the artifact boundary.

options.title: Move Host-Specific First
options.body: Defer the core command and keep the behavior in a host/plugin path until a missing core API is proven.

recommendation.title: Keep Draft For Cleanup And Pilot Proof
recommendation.body: Require the concrete cleanup first, then decide core landing after pilot or stress evidence clarifies the operational contract.
